overview: White plays 2.h3 and 3.g4 against the Dutch, offering a pawn to open the g- and h-files. After ...fxg4 hxg4 Nxg4 Black has an extra pawn and White tries for kingside pressure. Play is sharp and risky for White with little at stake for Black.

white_ideas.idea: Open the h-file with hxg4 and attack with Rh1 and Bf4/Bg5
Develop quickly with Nc3 and e3

black_ideas.idea: Take the pawn with ...fxg4 and ...Nxg4 and hold it

typical_structures.structure: Black pawn up with a broken f-pawn

character.notes: White is pawn down chasing the king along open files.

gambit.notes: White gives the g4 pawn and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: It looks over-ambitious; Black has little to fear.

sublines_that_differ.name: Black declines
sublines_that_differ.how: No pawn is taken and White weakens the king.

character.reason: A flank pawn sacrifice with both kings exposed.

gambit.reason: White offers the g4 pawn and Black can keep it.

structure.reason: The h-file half-opens for White while the centre stays fluid.

level.reason: A dubious line is not a beginner choice.

plans.reason: White uses the pawn sacrifice to open lines to the king.
